mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, temperatures are at 48 degrees under overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park. Under the full moon, the ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The overnight low will hit 46 degrees with no rain predicted.

WisDOT is inviting the community to learn about the US 18/151 Corridor Study. Meetings will be held in-person at Mount Horeb High School on November 18 and virtually on November 19 to discuss design concepts and gather public feedback.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow, plus Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and the Main Street Trick or Treat event this Wednesday.
In a noteworthy call from October 25, officers responded to a report of a vehicle stopped at an intersection where a 40-year-old Verona man was found passed out and subsequently arrested for O W I.

The shop is closed for the night, so we have wrapped up today's Pumpkin Pecan flavor. Be sure to stop by when the store opens tomorrow at 10:00 AM to enjoy the new flavor of the day, Chocolate Caramel Twist.
